notes.title: Global CBT Has Ended
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/68973158a4e073e348bfb29008f6ff5b082b18a2.jpg"][/img]Hello, Super Soldiers.[/p][p][/p][p]The SUPER PEOPLE Global CBT, which began on June 19, has officially ended[/p][p]as of June 29, 2025 (Sun) at 8:00 PM PDT.[/p][p][/p][p]We sincerely appreciate all the enthusiasm, support, and love you’ve shown throughout this test.[/p][p]This CBT wasn’t just a technical check—it was a meaningful chance for us to challenge ourselves again and reconnect with the community.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to your participation and encouragement, we’ve found the courage to move forward.[/p][p]📝 All feedback collected through the survey will be carefully reviewed 
and used to shape an even better version of SUPER PEOPLE in the future.[/p][p][/p][p]🔹  CBT End Schedule[/p][p]June 29, 2025 (Sun), 8:00 PM PDT[/p][p][/p][p]🔹Please Note[/p][p]All data, including nickname, level, gold, items, and gameplay records, will be reset at the end of the Closed Beta Test.[/p][p][/p][p]Your time, honest thoughts, and heartfelt support[/p][p]have become the driving force behind SUPER PEOPLE’s next chapter.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll never take this second chance for granted.[/p][p]We promise to return stronger, better—and ready to meet you again.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: [Complete] CBT Extension & Major Update Announcement (Updated)

[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/4fcd436ac9edff94efb8b57c79991f93d536f390.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear Super Soldiers,[/p][p][/p][p]We sincerely thank you for the tremendous interest, feedback, and 
constant suggestions you’ve shared during the current CBT.[/p][p]Every single piece of feedback has been deeply meaningful to our development team,

We are still actively working to bring this version as close to the classic experience as possible.[/p][p][/p][p]Now that a playable state is ready, we are extending the CBT to let you try both versions during the weekend.[/p][p]Your hands-on feedback will be essential in shaping the future direction of SUPER PEOPLE.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🗓️ CBT Extended Schedule[/b][/p][p]① US West (PDT): Until Sunday, June 29, 2025 at 8:00 PM[/p][p]② US East (EDT): Until Sunday, June 29, 2025 at 11:00 PM[/p][p]③ UTC: Until Monday, June 30, 2025 at 3:00 AM[/p][p]④ Korea (KST/UTC+9): Until Monday, June 30, 2025 at 12:00 PM

Removal of ultimate skill purchases from the in-game shop[/b][/p][p][b]5. Bonus gold rewards granted upon level-up to enhance progression[/b][/p][p][b]6. Balance Adjustment – Removed the knockback effect from Shotgun Master's [/b][b][i]Impact Flashbang[/i][/b][b] skill[/b][/p][p][b][strike]7. notes.title: 📢Notice on Feedback Reflected from Day 1 of CBT
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Super Soldiers,

We would like to extend our heartfelt thanks for your overwhelming interest and enthusiastic participation since the launch of the CBT.[/p][p]To honor your passion, our development team has been meticulously monitoring every single piece of feedback no comment or post goes unnotice

We’re not just listening we’re taking action. All departments are working in real-time, collaborating closely to reflect your voices within the CBT period whenever possible.[/p][p]Even within less than a day, we've engaged in deep discussions and made swift decisions to address key issues.[/p][p][/p][p]As a result, we’re preparing immediate patches for areas where rapid improvements are feasible. Please see below for the upcoming changes.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition, we are actively preparing a follow-up patch that includes more fundamental and large-scale changes beyond this update, and we are doing our best to share the details with you as soon as possible.[/p][p][/p][p][b]■ Upcoming Patch Details[/b][/p][quote][p][b]\[Update][/b][/p][p][u][b]1. Monster Balance Adjustments[/b][/u][/p][p] ① The number of regular monsters spawning in and around key landmarks has been reduced by approximately 30%.[/p][p] ② The HP of all regular monsters (excluding boss monsters) has been reduced by about 70%.
[/p][p][b][u]2. Ultimate Skill Shop Price Change[/u][/b][/p][p] ① The purchase price of ultimate skills sold in the shop has been unified to 9,000 Gold.[/p][p]
[b][u]3. Weapon Balance Adjustments[/u][/b][/p][p] ① Damage for all DMR weapons (M1 Garand, MINI-R, SKS) has been decreased.[/p][p] ② Among AR weapons, damage for M16A4 and G3 has been reduced.[/p][p][b]
[u]4. Other Improvements[/u][/b][/p][p] ① A 7,000 Gold stack will now rarely appear in the world.[/p][p] ② The number of loot box spawns in key landmark areas has been reduced by approximately 30%.[/p][p] ③ Sound effects will no longer play when opening Lv2 loot boxes; only Lv3 (gold) boxes will generate sound.[/p][p]
[b]\[Bug Fixes & Other Improvements][/b][/p][p]1. Training Grounds are now fully operational.[/p][p]2. Applied mitigation to reduce the occurrence of the parachuting bug.[/p][p]3. Fixed an issue where matches could not end properly due to players remaining in the revival state.[/p][p]4. Fixed a bug where the Driver’s Nitro skill would not activate.[/p][p]5. Resolved an issue that caused network delay at the end of matches.[/p][p]6. Fixed abnormal client disconnection issues.[/p][/quote][p]We’re continuing to review and incorporate as many of your suggestions from the community as possible.[/p][p][/p][p]More specific details including final values and implementation dates will be shared in future patch notes and maintenance announcements. [/p][p]Please understand that certain figures are subject to change as development progresses.[/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback and support are the driving force behind our work.[/p][p]We truly believe that the CBT is not just a test, but a journey we’re building together with you. We’ll keep striving to deliver a more stable and enjoyable experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Please continue to share your thoughts and support with us.[/p][p]Thank you always.[/p][p][/p][p]SUPER PEOPLE Dev. notes.title: User Feedback Analysis Report
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/33576d5e7e6f512d894c993a65a4013ebe700e34.png[/img]
Hello Super Soldiers,

Thanks again to everyone who participated in the recent community discussion!
We were able to get a sense of what many of you care about, and it's clear that certain ideas really resonated across the board.

While we can’t promise changes in a specific direction just yet, all your feedback is helping us understand what the Super People experience means to you.

Let’s keep the conversation going—your voices continue to shape the spirit of this game.

[b]We'll be back next week with something you can definitely look forward to, Super Soldiers… Stay tuned![/b]		

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/bf7533b1f62aada470dcd06bda0cac57b8c95584.png[/img]
			
[u][b]1. Total Number of Discussion Posts[/b][/u]
- Total posts: Approximately 440 discussion threads (as of June 4, 12 PM KST)	

[u][b]2. Key Insights[/b][/u]	
A. Desire to Return to SP1: Many users hope for not just a return, but a reconstruction based on SP1’s original charm and completeness.			
B. Strong Resistance to PvE Content: There is significant opposition to PvE, with calls for it to be either separated into its own mode or completely removed.			
C. Positive Response to Transparent Communication: Users appreciate recent efforts but demand continued reflection of feedback to rebuild trust.			
D. Cheat Prevention & Performance Optimization: These are identified as essential prerequisites for player return.

notes.title: Director’s Letter #3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/0002e0931ea74093b33f21f90576cbe2eb72aae9.png[/img]Dear all Players,
Greetings. This is Hur Min, Director of Super People.

I want to thank every single one of you who asked us to bring the game back. 
Your messages, your passion, and your belief in SUPER PEOPLE meant the world to us. 
And it made us ask ourselves: if we’re coming back how do we come back better?

We didn’t want to return with just a few tweaks. That wouldn’t be enough. 
You deserve something more exciting, more surprising something worth your time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/bf7533b1f62aada470dcd06bda0cac57b8c95584.png[/img]

So we took a step back and asked ourselves what makes SUPER PEOPLE different. 
The answer was clear: [u][b]our characters, and the feeling of growing stronger mid match.[/b][/u] 
The way each class plays, the rush of unleashing an ultimate, the uniqueness you feel when you pick your favorite that’s something we love, and something we wanted to build on. So we’re keeping that heart, and pushing it even further.

But progression how you grow during a match was something we felt could be more.
We thought long and hard about how to make that growth truly fun and meaningful. 

And we realized… we needed monsters. [u][b]Yes, monsters.[/b][/u]

Now, you’ll find powerful enemies in the field. 
Regular creatures. Mid bosses. Even final bosses. 
Defeat them, and you’ll earn gold and gear. 
The greater the challenge, the greater the reward. 
It’s not just PvP anymore. It’s a battlefield full of choices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/bf7533b1f62aada470dcd06bda0cac57b8c95584.png[/img]

And Gold? You can now use it to buy weapons and skills through a [u][b]brand-new in-game shop[/b][/u]. 
Want to jump higher, flank smarter, turn the tide with a surprise ultimate? It’s all there. 
And the decisions you make what to buy, when to buy, what to risk create a whole new layer of strategy.

You can even earn or purchase powerful abilities like resurrection or mobility skills, which open up entirely new metas. Every match becomes a story of how you build your strength, step by step. Do you upgrade your rifle, or unlock a skill that flips the fight? Do you hold on to what you have, or trade it in for something bolder?

We’ve added just a bit of risk to how items are delivered through your personal supply drop. It makes those decisions matter even more. And if you’re lucky enough to take down a boss? You might just get a rare skill drop along with your loot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/bf7533b1f62aada470dcd06bda0cac57b8c95584.png[/img]

We’re also adding new ways to shift the balance of power mid-match.
[u][b]Capture the Altar of Buffs[/b][/u], and gain a temporary advantage. 
It’s one more way to give smart, strategic players the chance to turn the game around.

As the game continues to evolve, we're also making ongoing [u][b]updates to the UI[/b][/u] to keep up with those changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/bf7533b1f62aada470dcd06bda0cac57b8c95584.png[/img]

All of these systems are new. 
And because of that, we won’t jump straight into Early Access again.

We need to test it, shape it, and refine it with your feedback. 
That’s why we’re starting with a Closed Beta Test.

If things go well, we’ll return to Early Access as quickly as we can.

SUPER PEOPLE is evolving into something new. It’s no longer just another battle royale. 
It’s our own kind of game now one that blends PvP and PvE, risk and reward, strategy and chaos. And I truly believe it’s something special.

Thank you, sincerely, for your trust—and for waiting for us.

We’re coming back soon. 

See you in the field,
[u][b]Hur Min, Director of Super People[/b][/u]

notes.title: After shutting down in 2023, failed battle royale Super People is back
notes.notes:
My favorite battle royale ever made was Sharkmob's Bloodhunt. Reimagining the Vampire: The Masquerade universe in a new, unique way, its rain-soaked Prague and slick cosmetics meant it shot straight to the top of my 'favorite PC games' list, only to be killed off a couple of years later. I know how it feels to watch one of my favorite titles bite the dust, ruined by cheaters and bad actors, so I can empathize with the dedicated Super People players who were there when it breathed its last back in 2023. But, in news I really didn't expect to write today, Wonder People's multiplayer shooter is back, and it's holding a new closed beta test next month.

notes.title: Director’s Letter #2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/f8aa12a11b48f62877a11dfb4559419c3316e6db.png[/img]

Dear all Players,
Greetings. This is Hur Min, Director of Super People.

As we’ve been developing Super People, we’ve faced many challenges. 
I’d like to take this opportunity to openly share with you the struggles we’ve encountered and how we’re working to resolve them.

[i][u][b]1. The Ongoing Struggle Against Cheaters[/b]
[/u][/i][quote]One of the most persistent issues in any shooter game is cheating. Fundamentally, it's incredibly difficult to eliminate cheats entirely. 
Critical information such as player location and hit registration must be processed on the client side for responsiveness this unfortunately opens the door for hackers to exploit and create tools like wallhacks or aimbots.

Although we employ several layers of detection, in the end, it often comes down to manual verification and reporting, handled by our internal team. 
We are a small indie studio with fewer than 30 people across development, service, and marketing. Despite our limitations, we are passionately dedicated to improving the game and have never given up. Recognizing the limits of internal monitoring, we’ve decided to launch a jury system to enlist the help of our players. 

Here's how it works: when a player accumulates multiple reports, gameplay footage will be reviewed by members of the community.  You, the players, will determine whether cheating occurred. We will take disciplinary action based on these verdicts. 
To support this system, we will reward honest and accurate reviewers with in-game incentives based on their reliability and performance.

Additionally, while phone number verification may seem useful, it provides limited protection. 
Hackers often bundle hacks with virtual phone number verification, making the process more of a hassle than an effective defense.

Since our game is free-to-play, it’s possible to create unlimited accounts using virtual numbers, which has made phone verification virtually ineffective. That said, we’re still reconsidering the possibility of requiring phone verification for future ranked matches.

In short, we know we cannot fully block all cheats. Instead, our focus is on enabling swift and fair action through your participation to keep cheaters out of our community.[/quote]
[i][u][b]2. Balancing Characters and Weapons[/b]
[/u][/i][quote]In the past, we focused on delivering powerful moments from the attacker’s perspective.
With this new version, we’re designing to reduce unfair or frustrating situations for those on the receiving end.
We are also working to elevate underused characters. 
For example:[list]
[*]To improve Driver utility, we’ve reduced vehicle spawns and added a fuel mechanic.
[*]Titans and Demolitions have been adjusted to enhance their impact and appeal.
[*]Shotgun Master’s super jump cooldown has been increased and its damage has been slightly reduced.
[*]The Gas Soldier’s ultimate damage has also been reduced to address complaints about sudden deaths from behind walls.
[/list]
And weapons are being rebalanced too:[list]
[*]Shotgun damage was slightly reduced and recoil increased.
[*]The underused G3 has been modified to allow three-round burst fire.
[*]the PPSH can now equip scopes.
[*]Spawn rates for DMRs and sniper rifles have been lowered to increase their value.
[/list]
We’ve also fine-tuned gunplay by increasing recoil slightly across the board to enhance the “feel” of shooting. This is based on real shooting range testing to better reflect the impact of recoil, especially for pistols and shotguns. We’re still exploring ways to realistically integrate this into the gameplay experience.

Simply put, we’re toning down some overpowered weapons and characters while giving meaningful buffs to those that have been overlooked.

We’ll provide a detailed breakdown of these balance changes once the rework is complete.[/quote]

[i][u][b]3. Addressing the Frustration of Sudden Death After Hard-Earned Progress[/b]
[/u][/i][quote]We know how disheartening it can be to lose all progress in an instant. 
To ease this, we’re introducing a resurrection skill when your character has reached a certain level of progression, you’ll be able to acquire the ability to come back to life.[/quote]

[i][u][b]4. Improving the Sense of Growth[/b]
[/u][/i][quote]Growth in Super People should feel rewarding and meaningful. 
With the addition of the resurrection skill, we are leaning into deeper and more layered progression.     
We believe this will be instantly noticeable once you play.[/quote]

[i][u][b]5. Simplifying the Game for Newcomers[/b]
[/u][/i][quote]We’ve removed features that complicated gameplay or confused new players:
Specialized weapons, energy bars, and the sliding skill have all been eliminated.
The sliding skill may return later under specific acquisition conditions.
We’ve also removed the blueprint system, which could be perceived as a pay-to-win element, in order to maintain fair and competitive play.[/quote]

[u][i][b]6. Enhancing Character Identity[/b]
[/i][/u][quote]Each class now starts the match with a distinct outfit, making it easy to recognize which class you're up against at a glance.
We’re currently preparing a new character—not limited to just handling guns, but aiming to show something truly new.
Although it won’t be applied in this test, we’re also working on adjusting the female character’s body proportions. In the past, we received a lot of compliments from players saying our characters looked great, and we really appreciated that. so we're working to make the characters even more lovable.[/quote]
Many more changes are in the works. We’ll share more detailed updates as soon as things are finalized.

As a small independent studio, we rely deeply on your support.
Please actively share the thrilling experience of Super People with those who’ve played it before, as well as with new gamers who haven’t tried it yet.

We look forward to seeing you in-game soon.

Warm regards,

Hur Min, Director of Super People

notes.title: Director's letter
notes.notes:
Hello, SuperSoldiers!
This is Hur Min, Director of Super People at Wonder People.

First of all, I sincerely thank everyone who has continued to show unwavering interest and affection for Super People across various communities.

Since the end of Super People 2 Early Access, I have found myself asking the same questions every day:
"If only we had done things a little differently..."
"Is it really possible to try again?"

But as time passed, the messages we received—from community channels, Steam reviews, and even direct emails made one thing clear:
"I want to play Super People again."
"I miss the fun we had back then."

We listened closely to the voices of those who still wanted Super People, and we made a promise to bring it back in the first half of 2025.

Before anything else, we decided to be honest with ourselves.
We took a hard look at what made the game truly fun, what must never be lost, and we are now in the final phase of refining and distinguishing Super People even further.

In June 2025, Super People will return with an upgraded Closed Beta Test.
The unforgettable fun you loved will remain and it will come back even better than before.

We are still working tirelessly toward Super People's success.
This challenge was a life-defining choice for us, and we believe it remains a unique and special memory for all of you as well.

This relaunch is not just a restoration.
It is our promise to confront the moments when we were at our best and to bring the excitement and emotion of those memories back to life.

Although we are starting small, we are meticulously preparing to ensure a more stable service and a clearer, stronger direction.
Above all, we are moving forward with a new level of determination and responsibility.

To once again deliver the Super People experience you loved
in its most polished and complete form
we are giving everything we have, right up to the very last moment.

We look forward to seeing you again soon. Please stay excited.
And once again, thank you sincerely for believing in us and waiting.

— Hur Min, Director of Super People
